thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: inference-queue-prod fired (HIGH) — queue depth 2.1k, p95 wait 18s, autoscaler lagging. Pager: @eng-oncall, @oncall
ira_oncall: ack @incident-bot — I'm the responder. Starting triage now.
sam_infra: looking... seeing a bunch of pods stuck in Pending with reason=InsufficientCPU from nodepool-autoscale. nodepool target already at 120 (quota).
jamie_sre: confirmed in scale-controller logs: 
```
I0314 12:05:12 scale_controller.go:217] DesiredNodes 128 -> 128
E0314 12:05:13 cloudprovider.go:88] failed to increase nodepool size: quotaExceeded: cannot exceed maxNodes
```
No new nodes are being provisioned.
maria_prod: Product telemetry: ~2% 503 spike for customers using realtime-inference routes starting ~12:01. Ticket volume up.
ira_oncall: ok mitigation plan: 1) open emergency nodepool request to cloud console, 2) route non-critical tenants to fallback-model-2 (lower capacity) to reduce token pressure, 3) manual bump of autoscaler min replicas to 4 for hotcells.
sam_infra: raising a support request with cloud quota team (gcloud request created: SR-87921). Meanwhile I can clone nodepool to a new pool with different machine type to bypass soft limit — starting manual spinup of 8 n1-highmem-equivalent nodes.
jamie_sre: manual commands I'm running:
```
# scale down low-priority deployments
kubectl -n inference scale deployment lp-backend --replicas=0
# set emergency min for hotpath
kubectl -n inference patch hpa hotpath-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
```
ira_oncall: started runbook 'hotcell-warmup' — dispatching deploy-bot actions. Deploy-bot: can you start the fallback routing change?
deploy-bot: routing update in progress: switching 30% of realtime traffic for org=beta to fallback-model-2 -> UID run-2026-03-14-1208.
maria_prod: adding a quick customer notice in status page draft: "We are mitigating increased latency and 503s for realtime inference; engineers investigating."
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation triggered (10m without resolution) — paging secondary escalation policy.
jamie_sre: hot nodes from manual pool are joining, but KV cache warmup is slow; expect improvements in ~6-8 minutes after nodes ready.
sam_infra: cloud support responded: quota increase is approved in principle but may take ~45m to apply. We should assume manual pool is primary short-term mitigation.
ira_oncall: current status: queue depth down to 900, p95 wait 7s. Keeping incident open. I'm staying on this thread; will update every 5–10 minutes. If anyone sees customer-facing regression, post here and tag me. :thumbsup:
jamie_sre: note for followup: add autoscaler health check to alert when desired>actual for >120s; add quota guardrail runbook.
ira_oncall: acknowledged. ETA for full recovery ~20–30m. Will coordinate handoff to daytime oncall in 30m if still active"
